lines.vo: Ever feel like your life is a storm, and God is asleep?
One evening, Jesus told His disciples: let's cross over to the other side of the lake.
Out on the water, a furious storm hit. Waves broke over the boat, and it was filling up.
These men were fishermen. They knew this lake. And they were terrified.
And Jesus? He was in the back of the boat, asleep on a cushion.
They woke Him up. Teacher, don't you care if we drown?
Jesus got up and spoke to the wind and the waves. Quiet. Be still.
The wind stopped, and it was completely calm.
Then He asked them: why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?
They had the One who made the sea, sleeping right there in their boat.
Whatever storm you're in tonight, He's in the boat with you.
